data.name: Devdutt
data.gender_notes: Devdutt is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devdutt is a compound name derived from Sanskrit. 'Dev' meaning 'god' and 'dutt' meaning 'servant' or 'son of god'. This name is given to a boy to signify that he is a god in his own right and a servant or son of the supreme god. The name Devdutt carries the meaning “God of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devdutt usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with divine origin and meaning.
data.etymology: Devdutt belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devdutt total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
